module shipping_rules
  purpose: Shipping cost and delivery rules for the web shop, called from the host application.
  tags: shipping, pricing, embedding

public type Destination is one of
  purpose: Where the parcel goes, as the shop groups its markets.
  Domestic
  Europe
  International
end

public type Parcel
  purpose: What the host passes in when it asks for a quote.
  has weight_grams: Integer where weight_grams is greater than 0
  has destination: Destination
  has order_total: Decimal where order_total is at least 0
  can FromJson
end

public type Quote
  purpose: What the host gets back for one parcel.
  has cost: Decimal
  has business_days: Integer
  has free_shipping: Boolean
  can ToJson
end

public let free_shipping_threshold: Decimal be 50.00
  purpose: Domestic orders at or above this total ship free.

public function quote(parcel: Parcel) returns Quote
  purpose: Price and delivery time for one parcel; the host calls this at every checkout.
  example: quote(Parcel(weight_grams: 500, destination: Domestic, order_total: 60.00))
    is Quote(cost: 0, business_days: 2, free_shipping: true)
  example: quote(Parcel(weight_grams: 2500, destination: Europe, order_total: 20.00))
    is Quote(cost: 14.50, business_days: 5, free_shipping: false)

  let free be parcel.destination is Domestic
    and parcel.order_total is at least free_shipping_threshold
  let weight_cost be weight_steps(parcel.weight_grams).to_decimal() * 2.50
  let cost be if free then 0 otherwise base_cost(parcel.destination) + weight_cost end
  return Quote(cost: cost, business_days: delivery_days(parcel.destination), free_shipping: free)
end

public function weight_steps(weight_grams: Integer) returns Integer
  purpose: How many whole kilograms beyond the first the parcel weighs; each one adds a step.
  example: weight_steps(500) is 0
  example: weight_steps(1000) is 0
  example: weight_steps(1001) is 1
  example: weight_steps(2500) is 2

  return (weight_grams - 1).quotient(1000)
end

function base_cost(destination: Destination) returns Decimal
  match destination
    when Domestic then return 4.90
    when Europe then return 9.50
    when International then return 19.90
  end
end

function delivery_days(destination: Destination) returns Integer
  match destination
    when Domestic then return 2
    when Europe then return 5
    when International then return 10
  end
end
